title: An old bank closed: its money moved out by the closing's transfer, its bill ends on the closing day (decision P6)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027. The main bank holds 200,000 and an old bank 30,000. Pay of 250,000 lands in the main bank on the 25th (moved earlier) and starts the period; a gym bill of 5,000 is paid from the old bank on the 15th (moved later). On Fri 8 Jan the person closes the old bank: its final figure is 30,000, and the closing asks for a transfer of all of it to the main bank. The gym bill's schedule ends on 8 Jan. No Free to spend amount is set. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the transfer the closing asks for: the old bank's whole final figure

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 5,000 (gym, Fri 15 Jan, from the old bank) = 5,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 200,000 (Bank today, its lowest to the second next pay on Thu 25 Feb) + 30,000 (Old bank today) - 5,000 (gym 15 Jan) - 5,000 (gym 15 Feb) = 220,000

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 200,000 (opening) + 30,000 (moved from the old bank at the closing) = 230,000

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.note: The gym's schedule ended on the closing day, 8 Jan, so 15 Jan is not expected.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 230,000 (Bank today, its lowest to Thu 25 Feb) + 0 (Old bank, closed: no gym after 8 Jan) = 230,000
asks.note: Before P6 the gym kept coming out of the empty old bank: 10,000 short, so the headline said 220,000 and warned.

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The old bank is closed with nothing in it and nothing more due from it, so it cannot go below its minimum.
